dedupe_keys.name: real dataset from broadband customers of a brazilian telecom operator

description: University of Minho and Federal University of Uberlândia researchers publish anonymised modem measurements and complaint labels from a Brazilian broadband operator. The January 2024 deposit provides a UTF-8 CSV, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Collection ran from January to June 2023 and covers optical network terminals serving GPON customers through home Wi-Fi. Fields include latency, jitter, packet loss, modem-rated 2.4 and 5 GHz channel quality, counts of devices more than ten metres away and a binary complaint indicator. These observations can calibrate service-quality and customer-response assumptions in broadband simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. For complainants, measurements are selected on the last complaint day; for other users, the final collected measurements are used. This asymmetric selection should not be treated as a uniform time-series sample. Operator identity, customer count, latency units and representativeness remain unknown from the public documentation. The CSV was not downloaded.
